svg.title: Farlands
svg.desc: Farlands — a voxel engine written from scratch in C++20 and Vulkan; an isometric island cut from the real seed-42 world floats next to the title.

g.text: A voxel engine built from scratch in C++ & Vulkan.
HDR renderer · atmosphere & volumetric clouds · reflective water · multithreaded infinite world

svg.text: island = real 20×20 patch of the seed-42 world (x -368, z 184) · cherry grove, oaks, beach, lake
